source_selection.NORMATIVE: Must have an official preserved source version and byte-proven pinpoint for claims about requirements, legal interpretation, or technical norms
source_selection.EDITORIAL: Authored/commentary evidence must preserve author, publisher, rights and version; never substitutes a normative source for normative claims
source_selection.MIXED: Normative and editorial evidence both required; commentary explains or contextualizes normative root

non_normative_note: Application identity, billing, logs and infrastructure use technical/operational contracts; they must not masquerade as source-grounded domain knowledge.
